from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
os.chdir('/home/data4/xiangyu/BioDSA/workdir')

for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    atoms.append((a.GetSymbol(),(p.x,p.y,p.z)))

    mf.conv_tol=1e-10

    occ=mf.mo_occ
    homo=float(np.max(mf.mo_energy[occ>0]))
    lumo=float(np.min(mf.mo_energy[occ==0]))
    print('structure:',smiles)
    print('method: B3LYP/def2-SVP, MMFF94-optimized geometry')
    print('SCF converged:',mf.converged)
    print('total energy (Ha):',f'{e:.12f}')
    print('HOMO (Ha):',f'{homo:.12f}')
    print('LUMO (Ha):',f'{lumo:.12f}')
    print('gap (Ha):',f'{lumo-homo:.12f}')", 'language': 'python'}
